decisions.reason: Although distant from the core and only mentioned without results, the recruitment service uses the firm's existing crewing infrastructure and has been publicly offered for two years, so management is inclined to persist and treat weak traction as a start-up effect.
Superyacht crew recruitment builds directly on the firm's core crewing network and has been on the market since 2023, so dropping it would contradict earlier commitments at little cost saving.
The Smart Academy is a highly visible, publicly announced initiative with a growing partner network of six institutions, central to the firm's training and integrated-solutions direction.
Emissions monitoring and compliance is close to the core, regulation-driven by FuelEU Maritime, publicly showcased with successful delivery, and central to the announced environmental direction.
The FuelEU dashboard is integrated into the firm's PAL software, which embeds substantial sunk investment and ties it to the publicly committed digitalisation and compliance strategy.
The cost simulation tool is part of the integrated FuelEU offering in PAL software, so management will persist with it as a complement to the dashboard and compliance services.
